assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production panoramic world-map background for the fullscreen hub in Sylve, a hand-painted woodland fantasy card game.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing village illustration to expand and recompose, preserving the exact same painterly art direction, architecture and recognizable landmarks.
Primary request: create a MUCH WIDER continuous landscape, 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3840 x 1280 pixels. Extend the forest valley on both sides to accommodate new buildings and future expansion. Keep the five original landmarks clearly recognizable in the central village: purple-roofed archive tower with a large open book on the upper left, teal-roofed guardian castle in the upper center, luminous emerald sanctuary upper right, red-roofed timber workshop lower left, round stone arena lower right. Add exactly TWO distinct mine buildings in the newly expanded side wings, with paths connecting them to the central village.
Composition/framing: wide panoramic elevated three-quarter/isometric view; NO letterboxing. The original five buildings are grouped across the middle 50 percent of the total image. Their centers are approximately: archives at (35%,32%), guardian house at (50%,32%), sanctuary at (65%,32%), workshop at (37%,65%), arena at (63%,65%). The GOLD MINE is in the left wing, centered at (13%,52%): a broad rocky hillside tunnel framed by dark timber supports, an amber-lit entrance, visible rich gold veins, a small wooden hoist and a mining cart filled with golden ore. The EMERALD MINE is in the right wing, centered at (87%,52%): a rocky hillside tunnel with timber supports, emerald-green crystal veins and a mining cart filled with luminous uncut emerald crystals; it must read as a working mine, distinct from the crystal sanctuary. The mines should be large, charming, individually identifiable and fully visible, with room above them for future HTML collect icons. Leave naturally integrated unbuilt grassy clearings with branching paths between the mines and central village, and a broad lower foreground with a few empty buildable terraces for future buildings. Landmark silhouettes must never overlap. Top 12% and bottom 15% mostly scenery, so the app header and footer have room.
Style/medium: polished richly detailed painterly 2D storybook fantasy, warm forest greens, honey-gold late-afternoon sunshine, cream stone, aged brass, moss, teal roofs, soft distant mountains, little waterfalls, curved stone bridges and woodland flowers. Match the source. Camera height and object scale consistent across the whole panorama.
Constraints: one opaque edge-to-edge illustration. All seven buildings present, exactly two mines. No people, no characters, no text, no labels, no numbers, no interface, no currency collection bubbles, no icons, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no repeated buildings.
